_comment: Skip-count ratchet. scripts/check_skip_budget.py fails a suite whose skip
count EXCEEDS max_skipped. Skips may only go DOWN: when you eliminate one,
lower the number in the same commit. If you must add a legitimate skip,
raise it in the same commit and justify it in the commit body.
The number exists because skips are how a suite quietly stops testing. A
run reporting '340 passed, 176 skipped' looks green and proves much less

sky.boss runs one suite. The `integration` entry skeletor ships was dropped rather than left at zero: a budget for a suite nothing runs is a number that can never move, and it reads as coverage this repo does not have.
